summary: Tested 3 bug fixes: 1) PDF Generation for Sales Orders - WORKING (shows 'SALES ORDER' title, no signature box, valid QR), 2) RBAC Payments - WORKING (store_code filter enforced), 3) Material Transfer DC - WORKING (dropdown updates From/To locations). Fixed route ordering bug in payment_receipt_routes.py.

PDF Generation: Signature box conditionally rendered only for invoices (not sales orders)
